Teach read_climate() a data source

Source: R/read_climate.R
register_source.Rd

Registers the conventions of a dataset, so read_climate() recognises its files and records the right variable, unit, kind and dates. Registered sources are tried before the built-in ones (era5, chirps, wfde5, gaez), for the rest of the session.

Usage

register_source(
  name,
  detect,
  variable = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  kind = NULL,
  time = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Name of the source, e.g. "agera5".

detect

A regular expression matched, ignoring case, against the file names and layer names; or a function of the raster and its file names returning TRUE when the files belong to the source.

variable, unit, kind

Conventions of the source; see Details.

time

Optional function of the raster and its file names returning one date (or date-time) per layer, or NULL.

Value

The names of the registered sources, invisibly.

Details

Each of variable, unit and kind is either a fixed string or a function of the raster and its file names (unit also receives the time step) returning a string or NULL.

See also

read_climate(), list_sources()

Examples

register_source("agera5", detect = "AgERA5", unit = "C")
list_sources()
#> [1] "agera5" "era5"   "chirps" "wfde5"  "gaez"
